The main takeaway from our work is that
MOST is a powerful instrument for transit timing measurements.

the MOST data set is an example of a new type of data set for exoplanet systems that can be acquired with a modest investment of time, and that will be of great utility in the future for testing models for exoplanetary system evolution.
